overview.purpose_zh: 这张桑基图用来看访客从不同来源进入网站后，分别流向哪些页面，又在哪里离开。
works_zh: 适合展示有分叉、会汇合的路径，比如从流量来源到下单。
适合比较各条路径的流量大小，带子越宽流量越大。

understanding.read_zh: 从左往右读：左边是来源，中间是页面，右边是结果。每条带的宽度代表人数，带子分叉就是流量分开，带子通向 Exit 就是有人在这里离开。

elements.note_zh: 每个节点是一个来源、页面或结果，比如商品页或 Exit。
连接两个节点的带子，越宽表示流过的人越多。
通向 Exit 节点的带子，代表在这里结束访问的人。
从左到右的每一列代表路径中的一个阶段。

look_for_zh: 最宽的带子出现在哪两个节点之间
离开分支在哪个页面之后最粗

observations.en: The product page receives 8,600 visits but sends only 3,600 to the cart; 5,000 leave there.
observations.zh: 商品页一共收到 8,600 次访问，但只有 3,600 次走向购物车，有 5,000 次在这里离开。

observations.en: Search (4,200) and Social (2,600) are the two main routes into the product page, and Direct adds 1,800.
observations.zh: 搜索（4,200）和社交（2,600）是通往商品页的两条主要路径，直接访问再补充 1,800。

observations.en: Most exits happen early: 5,000 leave after the product page, 1,500 after the cart, and 800 after checkout.
observations.zh: 大多数离开发生在前面：商品页之后走掉 5,000 人，购物车之后 1,500 人，结账之后 800 人。

observations.en: Social splits its 4,000 visits between the product page (2,600) and the promo page (1,400).
observations.zh: 社交带来的 4,000 次访问分成两路：2,600 次去商品页，1,400 次去促销页。

observations.en: Only 2,200 purchases come out of the whole journey, fewer than the 7,800 exits.
observations.zh: 整条路径最后只产生 2,200 笔购买，比 7,800 次离开还少。

describe.en: The sankey diagram shows how 8,600 visits to the product page split between the cart and an exit.
describe.zh: 这张桑基图展示到达商品页的 8,600 次访问如何分向购物车和离开。
describe.pattern: The chart shows + what + for whom + over what period
alternatives: The chart shows the path from traffic source to purchase.
The diagram shows where visitors go after the product page.

describe.en: The flow from the product page to the cart is 3,600 users, while 5,000 users exit at the same point.
describe.zh: 从商品页流向购物车的有 3,600 人，同时有 5,000 人在这里离开。
describe.pattern: the flow of + noun + from ... to ... / flow into + place
alternatives: The flow into the cart is 3,600 users.
5,000 users leave the flow after the product page.

describe.en: Every purchase in the diagram passes through the cart before checkout.
describe.zh: 这张图里每一笔购买在结账前都要经过购物车。
describe.pattern: pass through + stage / noun + passes through
alternatives: All buyers pass through the cart first.
The cart is the one stage every purchase passes through.

describe.en: The transition from cart to checkout carries 3,000 of the 4,500 cart arrivals.
describe.zh: 从购物车到结账的过渡带走了 4,500 名到访购物车的人中的 3,000 人。
describe.pattern: the transition from A to B / transition to + noun
alternatives: 3,000 of the 4,500 cart arrivals move on to checkout.

describe.en: The number who exit after the product page is more than the 3,600 who move on to the cart: 5,000 people leave.
describe.zh: 商品页之后的离开人数超过了继续去购物车的 3,600 人：有 5,000 人离开。
describe.pattern: more than + number / more than + twice the + noun
alternatives: 5,000 users leave after the product page, against 3,600 to the cart.
The product page loses 5,000 users, more than the 3,600 it passes on.

describe.en: The exit band after the product page is higher than any onward band: 5,000 against 3,600.
describe.zh: 商品页之后的离开分支比任何继续向前的分支都大：5,000 对 3,600。
describe.pattern: A + be + higher than + B / higher than + figure
alternatives: The product page exit figure is higher than the cart figure, 5,000 against 3,600.
More users leave after the product page than continue to the cart.

describe.en: Of the 7,800 exits, the 5,000 after the product page take the largest share.
describe.zh: 在 7,800 次离开中，商品页之后的 5,000 次占比最大。
describe.pattern: X has / holds / takes the largest share of + whole
alternatives: The product page accounts for the largest share of exits: 5,000 of 7,800.
Most exits, 5,000 out of 7,800, happen after the product page.

describe.en: What stands out is the width of the exit band after the product page: 5,000 users leave there.
describe.zh: 最突出的是商品页之后那条离开分支的宽度：有 5,000 人从这里离开。
describe.pattern: What stands out is + noun / how + adjective + clause
alternatives: What stands out most is how many users leave the product page.
The clearest feature is the 5,000 users who exit at the product page.

academic.en: The sankey diagram traces monthly website visits from three sources through to purchase. Search contributes 4,200 visits to the product page, Social 2,600 and Direct 1,800, so the product page receives 8,600 in total. Of these visits, 3,600 continue to the cart and 5,000 exit. The promo page receives 1,400 visits from Social, with 900 moving to the cart and 500 leaving. Cart arrivals total 4,500; 3,000 reach checkout and 2,200 result in purchase, while 7,800 visits end in an exit.
academic.zh: 这张桑基图追踪每月网站访客从三个来源到购买的流向。搜索向商品页带来 4,200 次访问，社交 2,600 次，直接访问 1,800 次，因此商品页共收到 8,600 次访问。其中 3,600 次继续进入购物车，5,000 次离开。促销页收到社交带来的 1,400 次访问，其中 900 次进入购物车，500 次离开。到达购物车的一共 4,500 次；3,000 次进入结账，2,200 次完成购买，另有 7,800 次访问以离开结束。

business.en: Our journey loses most traffic at the product page: 8,600 visits arrive there, but 5,000 leave immediately and only 3,600 reach the cart. Search is our strongest entry point at 4,200 visits, followed by Social at 2,600 and Direct at 1,800. Fixing product page conversion matters more to us than any later step, because our volumes fall from 4,500 cart arrivals to 2,200 purchases. We should put our next improvement effort into the product page before touching checkout.
business.zh: 我们的访问路径大部分流量丢在商品页：8,600 次访问到达那里，但 5,000 次立刻离开，只有 3,600 次进入购物车。搜索是我们最强的入口，带来 4,200 次访问，其次是社交的 2,600 次和直接访问的 1,800 次。对我们来说，改善商品页转化比后面任何一步都重要，因为流量从 4,500 次到达购物车一路降到 2,200 次购买。我们应该先把下一轮优化放在商品页，再动结账环节。

simple.en: This picture follows people through an online store. Search brings 4,200 visitors to the product page, Social brings 2,600, and Direct brings 1,800. That makes 8,600 people looking at a product. Only 3,600 go on to the cart, and 5,000 leave. Later, 3,000 people reach checkout and 2,200 buy something. Most people walk away right after looking at a product. The first step is where we lose them.
simple.zh: 这张图跟着人们走一遍网店。搜索把 4,200 人带到商品页，社交带来 2,600 人，直接访问带来 1,800 人，所以一共有 8,600 人在看商品。只有 3,600 人继续去购物车，5,000 人离开。再往后，3,000 人走到结账，2,200 人买了东西。大多数人是看完商品就走了。我们就是在第一步失去了他们。

language_notes.body_zh: 桑基图里读数量不只看标签，更要看带的宽度。两条带一比，宽的那条流量更大；分叉处的带宽加起来等于上游的带宽。
examples: The 5,000 exit band is wider than the 3,600 band to the cart.
The product page band splits into 3,600 to the cart and 5,000 to the exit.

language_notes.title_en: Exit is a node, not a verb
language_notes.body_zh: 图里的 Exit 是一个节点，代表访问在这里结束；写句子时可以说 users exit after the product page，也可以说 the Exit node receives 5,000 users。不要把 Exit 当成动词的过去式。
examples: The Exit node receives 5,000 users from the product page.
Users exit the site after the product page.

language_notes.body_zh: flow into 后面接目的地，flow from 后面接起点；一条路径两头都要说清时，用 from ... to ... 最省事。
examples: Search flows into the product page with 4,200 visits.
The flow from Search to the product page is 4,200.
